snp5.7:1.1: NIṬṬHITĀ. Upasīvamāṇarapacchā (6). "Eko ahaṃ Sakka mahantam oghaṃ icc-āyasmā Upasīvo anissito no visahāmi tārituṃ, ārammaṇaṃ brūhi samantacakkhu, yaṃ nissito ogham imaṃ tareyya". || || "Ākiñcaññaṃ
snp5.7:2.1: pekkhamāno satīmā Upasīvā ti Bhagavā ‘n' atthī' ti nissāya tarassu oghaṃ,| kāme pahāya virato kathāhi taṇhakkhayaṃ nattamahābhipassa". || ||
snp5.7:3.1: "Sabbesu kāmesu yo vītarāgo icc-āyasmā Upasīvo ākiñcaññaṃ nissito hitva-m-aññaṃ saññāvimokhe parame vimutto, tiṭṭhe nu so tattha anānuyāyī". || ||
snp5.7:4.1: 1072."Sabbesu kāmesu yo vītarāgo Upasīvā ti Bhagavā ākiñcaññaṃ nissito hitva-m-aññaṃ saññāvimokhe parame vimutto, tiṭṭheyya so tattha anānuyāyī". || ||
snp5.7:5.1: "Tiṭṭhe ce so tattha anānuyāyī pūgam pi vassānaṃ samantacakkhu, tatth' eva so sītisiyā vimutto, bhavetha viññāṇaṃ tathāvidhassa". || ||
snp5.7:6.1: "Accī yathā vātavegena khitto Upasīvā ti Bhagavā atthaṃ paleti na upeti saṃkhaṃ,| evaṃ munī nāmakāyā vimutto atthaṃ paleti na upeti saṃkhaṃ". || ||
snp5.7:7.1: "Atthaṇ gato so uda vā so n' atthi udāhu ve sassatiyā arogo, tam me munī sādhu viyākarohi, tathā hi te vidito esa dhammo". || ||
snp5.7:8.1: "Atthaṇ gatassa na pamāṇam atthi, Upasīvā ti Bhagavā yena naṃ vajju, taṃ tassa n' atthi, sabbesu dhammesu samūhatesu samūhatā vādapathā pi sabbe" ti || || UPASĪVAMĀṆAVAPUCCHĀ NIṬṬHITĀ.
